name: Brownout
author: fonsgaudii
description: Battery brownout mode: on unplug or low battery, apply an emergency profile — dim display, strip compositor effects, power-saver, pause user-chosen services. With hysteresis, a usage-ranked pause chooser, an adjustable trigger threshold, manual overrides and a bar widget.

barWidget.description: Brownout mode indicator: status, mode switch, and the pause chooser
